definitions.gloss: chief mourner; host of a funeral
definitions.explanation: The person who represents the bereaved family at a funeral, usually the spouse or eldest child of the deceased. The chief mourner receives condolences, greets the guests, and gives a short speech of thanks at the end of the ceremony.

examples.japanese: {喪主|もしゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長男|ちょうなん}→長男：14519_chounan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{務|つと}めた→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: The eldest son served as chief mourner.

examples.japanese: {喪主|もしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{参列者|さんれつしゃ}→参列者：28435_sanretsusha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The chief mourner thanked the people attending.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{亡|な}くなり→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧、⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{喪主|もしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: When my father died, I ended up serving as chief mourner in my mother's place.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {喪主|もしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as chief mourner
- {喪主|もしゅ}⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: the chief mourner's speech of thanks
- {喪主|もしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧・{喪主|もしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長男|ちょうなん}→長男：14519_chounan⟧: the chief mourner's wife, eldest son (how relatives are named in funeral notices)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The chief mourner's name appears on the funeral notice and decides the arrangements with the funeral company. Guests bring condolence money (⟦{香典|こうでん}→香典：06127_kouden⟧), which the family later answers with a return gift.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{遺族|いぞく}→遺族：14886_izoku⟧: the bereaved family as a whole
